text:
eva_devex: Quick FYI — ran into a weird combo of issues when using the Redwood JS SDK from a Next.js middleware (Edge runtime) on Vercel. build passes but runtime throws in prod.

sam_runtime: what error are you seeing? can you paste the stack?

eva_devex: gist of it: TypeError: crypto.getRandomValues is not a function -> originates inside our SDK's auth nonce code (we call globalThis.crypto.subtle / getRandomValues). Local dev (next dev) fine, but Vercel Edge fails. Also noticed some consumers hit import resolution failures (CJS vs ESM) when they bundle the middleware.

maya_prodeng: edge runtime uses Web Crypto but the env shape can differ (wrapping by Vercel). Also timers/fs not available. did the stack show "require is not defined" anywhere?

eva_devex: yes one user had `ReferenceError: require is not defined` when they used `import redwood from 'redwood'` but their bundler ended up using cjs entry. package.json for the SDK currently has "main": "dist/index.cjs.js" and "module": "dist/index.esm.js" and an "exports" field but not distinguishing an edge-only entry.

cheng_ts: typing note — some folks import types via `import type {Client}from 'redwood'` and TS resolves to the CJS typings because our "types" points to a bundled d.ts. We might need conditional types in exports or `types` mapping for the edge entry. TS 4.7+ supports conditional exports for types with "exports" -> "types" subpath.

sam_runtime: short-term: we should avoid calling Node-specific crypto helpers at module init. Use a runtime-detect wrapper: const randomBytes = () => (globalThis.crypto?.getRandomValues ? ...) : fallback-to-webcrypto-poly or throw. For middleware we should prefer Web Crypto path.

eva_devex: hacked a patch locally: created dist/edge.mjs that only uses fetch/Request/Response-compatible bits and doesn't import node:crypto. Also added package.json exports: {
  "import": "./dist/index.esm.js",
  "require": "./dist/index.cjs.js",
  "edge": "./dist/edge.mjs",
  "types": "./dist/index.d.ts"
}
But Vercel's resolver didn't pick up the "edge" key — they don't look for a custom "edge" condition.

maya_prodeng: right — Node conditional exports only standard conditions (import, require, node, default). Vercel's edge bundler may use the browser condition or fall back to import. Two options: 1) publish an ESM entry that is edge-safe as default `import` (preferred), 2) add a documented subpath `redwood/edge` and ship edge-specific bundle so consumers can `import { createClient } from 'redwood/edge'` in middleware.

cheng_ts: For typings: produce `dist/edge.d.ts` and add an export map entry "./edge": { "types": "./dist/edge.d.ts", "import": "./dist/edge.mjs" } so TS users get correct types when they import from the subpath. That avoids relying on conditional types which are brittle across toolchains.

sam_runtime: agree. Implementation plan: (1) Add an edge-safe ESM build (rollup/tsup target: platform=browser, no node: imports). (2) Add "./edge" subpath in exports. (3) Guard runtime uses (lazy resolve crypto/fetch). (4) Add tests: run smoke in vercel dev/edge sandbox + unit tests that import the edge bundle with esbuild.

eva_devex: I'll draft the PR that adds the edge bundle + subpath and updates the README onboarding snippet with `import {createClient} from 'redwood/edge' // for Next middleware`. Also include migration note for folks who relied on default CJS require.

deploy-bot: deploy preview created: PR #634 — preview at https://deploy-preview.example.com (edge test page included).

maya_prodeng: small UX note — we should add a lint rule in examples and templates: use edge import in middleware templates. Prevents new users from copy/pasting the default import that may hit CJS.

eva_devex: good call. I'll update the Next middleware quickstart and add a tiny troubleshooting section: "Edge gotcha: crypto/require/ts types" with the quick import fix.

cheng_ts: I'll add the d.ts for edge and a test that `import type {Client} from 'redwood/edge'` resolves in a TS project.

sam_runtime: timeline? can we land patch this week? it's low risk (add bundle + docs) but want to run a couple prod smoke tests.

eva_devex: aiming for patch release 0.9.3 by Friday. will post PR link when ready. thanks all :pray:

maya_prodeng: thanks — will ping a couple customers that hit this to try the preview. :shipit:
